entries.title: Iran's supreme leader absent as senior officials attend ayatollah's funeral

entries.title: Watch: Lyse Doucet on emotion and politics at Tehran funeral of former supreme leader
entries.snippet: The BBC's chief international correspondent reports from Tehran where funeral events are taking place in honour of Iran's former leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

entries.title: Marine Le Pen appeal verdict: Why this moment matters for France
entries.snippet: The leader of France's National Rally leads the opinion polls ahead of the 2027 presidential election and will now find out if she can stand.

entries.title: A global hub for fake luxury goods, Vietnam cracks down on its black market
entries.snippet: The Trump administration wants Vietnam to stamp out its booming counterfeit industry. Locals are divided.

entries.snippet: Some of the famous guests have been posting on social media about the big day in New York.

entries.title: Super Typhoon Bavi makes landfall on US Pacific islands with huge wind gusts
entries.snippet: The storm, with winds of nearly 290km/h (180mph) and gusts of 350km/h, is lashing the island of Rota.

entries.title: Australia probes mystery space balls that washed up on beach
entries.snippet: Officials are searching for the origins of six pieces of space debris discovered on Forrest Beach in Queensland.

entries.title: 'Definitely felt a big bang': Delta plane hit by firework while landing in Chicago
entries.snippet: The plane had 52 passengers and six crew onboard. No injuries were reported.

entries.title: The African fishermen who blame Chinese trawlers for their woes
entries.snippet: Fishing crews in Sierra Leone say large Chinese ships are illegally hoovering up stocks.

entries.title: Thousands welcome home Cape Verde footballers after stunning World Cup run
entries.snippet: Tens of thousands of fans formed an ocean of blue outside the airport in capital city, Praia.

entries.title: Nigeria says two nationals killed in South Africa amid rise of anti-migrant attacks
entries.snippet: Nigeria's government said one of its nationals was reportedly killed by police officers "using gruesome interrogation techniques".

entries.title: Eight rescued from seaplane that made 'hard landing' in Manhattan river
entries.snippet: Eight people were removed from the Kodiak 100 seaplane by fire department units and two had minor injures.

entries.title: How Iran's new regime is very different to what came before
entries.snippet: Khamenei's funeral is another reminder of the change Iran has seen, but what does its new leadership want?

entries.snippet: Space Force and Customs and Border Patrol are using a rodeo as a way to drive up recruitment numbers.

entries.title: France survive Paraguay's 'disgraceful' and 'embarrassing' dark arts
entries.snippet: After dismantling all before them at this World Cup, France had to find a new way to win against a Paraguay side whose use of the dark arts angered many of those watching.

entries.title: Dior dress, Adam Sandler and a man of honour: What we know about Taylor and Travis's wedding
entries.snippet: The couple tied the knot in New York on Friday, after months of speculation about when, where and how it would happen.

entries.snippet: Temperature records were smashed in June - and scientists warn this is a sign of things to come.

entries.snippet: More than 2,000 primary schools are facing closure as enrolment numbers plummet.

entries.snippet: The BBC's chief international correspondent Lyse Doucet is in Tehran, where funeral events are taking place in honour of Iran's former leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

entries.title: Scorching heat and delays: How Washington DC marked America 250
entries.snippet: The United States of America marked its 250th birthday with fireworks, flyovers, some intense weather across the country.

entries.title: Y si sí: the phrase uniting Mexico during the World Cup
entries.snippet: Mexico's World Cup run has inspired a phrase heard across the country: "Y si sí." Or in English: "What if we can?" Anamaria Sayre reports from Mexico City.

entries.title: Thunderstorms, heat and wind will hamper efforts to contain Colorado wildfires
entries.snippet: Thunderstorms with high winds could make it more difficult to contain a massive wildfire that has scorched parts of southern Colorado.

entries.title: National Guard troops fatally shoot a man in downtown Memphis
entries.snippet: Memphis police say National Guard troops fired their weapons in the early morning hours of July 5, killing a man who was armed with a handgun. State investigators will handle the case.

entries.title: Folarin Balogun's ban is lifted by FIFA, allowing U.S. striker to play Belgium
entries.snippet: FIFA's Disciplinary Committee said it would suspend Balogun's one-game red card ban for a probationary period of one year. The Royal Belgian Football Federation said it was "astonished."

entries.title: Super Typhoon Bavi brings intense winds to Guam and surrounding Pacific islands
entries.snippet: People in the Northern Mariana Islands — remote U.S. territories in the Pacific Ocean — are dealing with intense winds and potential flooding from Super Typhoon Bavi.

entries.title: Construction is a man's game. These women are demolishing the barriers
entries.snippet: Women make up a miniscule 3% of construction workers in Kenya. But a nonprofit group is offering them a way to get into the game ... and to get ahead.

entries.title: A new law in California will clarify 'sell by' dates to reduce food waste
entries.snippet: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe speaks with Nick Lapis of Californians Against Waste about the new law that standardizes food label "use by" dates and how that reduces consumer confusion and tons of food waste.

entries.title: Pennsylvania's proposed data centers are bringing strangers together in protest
entries.snippet: Proposals to build six data centers in the small community of Archbald, Pennsylvania, have brought strangers together to fight the plans there — and elsewhere in the state.

entries.title: Paul Pelosi in hit-and-run in California, car left with major damage, authorities say
entries.snippet: The husband of former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi was involved in a hit-and-run in California that left a parked car with "major" damage, authorities said Saturday.

entries.title: Pastor freed from prison in China weeks after Trump requested his release
entries.snippet: A pastor of a prominent underground church who was detained in China in October has been released, less than two months after U.S. President Donald Trump brought up his case when meeting Chinese leader Xi Jinping.

entries.title: White House report brands Smithsonian leadership as radical activists who can't be trusted
entries.snippet: The report released late on Independence Day by the White House Domestic Policy Council comes in the midst of Trump's aggressive campaign to overhaul some of Washington's most sacred cultural and historic institutions.

entries.title: AP report: FIFA lifts U.S. player Balogun's red card suspension at World Cup after Trump calls Infantino
entries.snippet: "Thank you to FIFA for doing what was right, and reversing a great injustice!" Trump said in a statement on social media.

entries.title: National Guard members on patrol in Memphis fatally shoot man during pursuit, police say
entries.snippet: The soldiers in Memphis were responding with local police to reports of gunshots around 4 a.m. when they began pursuing an armed man fleeing on foot, the city's police department said.

entries.title: 7 OPEC+ countries agree to expand monthly oil production modestly as prices slide
entries.snippet: The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and its allies announced on Sunday that seven countries would expand oil production by a combined total of 188,000 barrels per day in August.

entries.title: Democrat Mallory McMorrow suspends her Michigan Senate campaign and scrambles the pivotal race
entries.snippet: McMorrow's exit comes after many Democrats increasingly viewed her as a long shot for the nomination. It also creates a fresh dynamic in one of the country's most closely watched Senate races.

entries.title: Unbearable heat suspected in 19 New Jersey deaths as high temperatures give way to thunderstorms
entries.snippet: New Jersey officials said Saturday that they began seeing what they believe are heat-related deaths as early as Thursday with most occurring in the central and northern parts of the state.

entries.title: NATO chief faces challenge at summit as Trump demands 'loyalty' and not just burden-sharing
entries.snippet: Since he started work as NATO secretary-general almost two years ago, Mark Rutte has spent much of his time trying to keep the United States anchored to the world's biggest military alliance.

entries.title: Residents in eastern Congo cling to hope as a new Ebola treatment trial begins
entries.snippet: At the Ebola treatment center inside Bunia's Evangelical Medical Center, in eastern Congo's Ituri province, the launch of the research was marked by urgency rather than ceremony.

entries.title: Trump's administration won't seek new bids to repair the Reflecting Pool
entries.snippet: Like President Donald Trump, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum said he was 100% sure that vandals caused the damage to the century-old Reflecting Pool on the National Mall.

entries.title: Khamenei's other sons appear at his funeral in Iran as new supreme leader remains in hiding
entries.snippet: The funeral was in part a show of unity and defiance as Iran demands a measure of control over the Strait of Hormuz, a vital waterway for global energy that it shut down during the war.

entries.title: WATCH: Trump delivers keynote address at 'Salute to America 250' event on the National Mall
entries.snippet: Speaking in Washington after storms prompted a roughly two-hour evacuation of the National Mall, Trump honored veterans, including several from World War II and one of the first Black officers to lead a Special Forces team in combat in Vietnam.

entries.title: Wildfires rage in Portugal, Greece and Spain while Greek authorities warn of toxic smoke
entries.snippet: Authorities urged residents in parts of Thessaloniki, Greece's second largest city, to remain indoors and shut their windows and doors due to toxic smoke from a burning recycling plant that was engulfed by a wildfire.

entries.title: Fireworks, heat, hot dogs and politics: America celebrates its 250th birthday
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump plans to speak on the National Mall before what is being billed as a historically enormous fireworks show that will rain down over the nation's capital.

entries.title: A child can drown in seconds. Doctors want more families to be prepared
entries.snippet: About 4,000 to 5,000 Americans drown each year. Most are adults who die in natural bodies of water, such as lakes, ponds or oceans.

entries.title: Pope marks July 4 by praying in Lampedusa for migrants who died seeking freedom and prosperity

entries.title: Searing heat and storms mar holiday with 3 children dead in Wisconsin and utility outages widespread

entries.title: Far-right Alternative for Germany party reelects leaders as protesters and police clash
entries.snippet: Alternative for Germany, or AfD, sought to show unity as it voted to extend the terms of Alice Weidel and Tino Chrupalla, who have headed it for four years as co-leaders and ran unopposed Saturday.

entries.title: Fireworks, heat and drought put this Fourth of July at high risk for wildfires
entries.snippet: Fireworks, from bottle rockets to Roman candles, start a lot of fires in the U.S. every year – 32,000 of them in 2023 alone. And each year there is a clear spike in human-caused fires on July 4.

entries.title: Lionel Messi scores 20th World Cup goal, extends streak to 8 games and takes Golden Boot lead
entries.snippet: Messi's goal in the 29th minute was the 20th of his World Cup career, extending his record and moving him two ahead of France's Kylian Mbappé on the all-time list.

entries.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce marry in front of famous friends at Madison Square Garden
entries.snippet: In a culture obsessed with famous couplings it may have been the apex celebrity wedding, with perhaps only royal unions getting more attention.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: World Cup: Trump thanks FIFA for suspending Balogun's red card ban
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump reportedly called Gianni Infantino to ask him to lift Falorin Balogun's red card ban to allow him to play against Belgium. The Belgian FA has called the decision "astonishing."

entries.title: Far-right AfD reaffirms ambition to govern Germany
entries.snippet: The AfD has strengthened its hardline leadership despite ongoing scrutiny from Germany's domestic intelligence agencies. Co-leader Alice Weidel says the far-right party is ready to govern after strong polling gains.

entries.title: Wildfires rage in Portugal, Greece, France and Spain
entries.snippet: Six countries in southern Europe have been hit by wildfires. One of the blazes, in southwestern France, could affect Monday's third stage of the Tour de France, authorities warn.

entries.title: Turkey steps up arrests ahead of NATO summit
entries.snippet: Journalists, academics and members of left-wing groups have reportedly been detained during police raids in several Turkish provinces. Turkey's capital Ankara is set to host a major NATO summit this week.

entries.title: Students leave Gaza to continue studies, others in limbo
entries.snippet: More than three school years since the start of Israel's war in Gaza, more Palestinian students are restarting studies at universities abroad. Education has yet to return to normal, as schools expand online teaching.

entries.title: Top Iranian officials attend day 2 of Ali Khamenei's funeral
entries.snippet: Three of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's sons made their first public appearances in months on Sunday. But the son who succeeded him as Iran's supreme leader, Motjaba Khamanei, was nowhere to be seen.

entries.title: Nigeria condemns deaths of 2 nationals in South Africa protests
entries.snippet: Nigeria claimed one of the victims was killed by police following anti-migrant marches that have fueled xenophobia.

entries.title: Cargo ship reportedly attacked in Red Sea off Yemen
entries.snippet: The UK Maritime Trade Office said a vessel was attacked 30 nautical miles southwest of Hodeida, which is under control of the Houthi rebels. The Iran-backed group recently vowed to resume attacks in the Red Sea.

entries.title: Germany news: AfD conference wraps up in Erfurt
entries.snippet: AfD leaders have used their party conference to underline their goal of entering government at state and federal level. Meanwhile, Germany travel complaints hit record in first half of 2026.

entries.title: UK Reform's Nigel Farage faces fresh misconduct allegations
entries.snippet: Populist right leader Nigel Farage has been referred to the UK parliament's standards watchdog after a report that he failed to declare benefits. The Reform UK leader is already under investigation over a separate gift.

entries.title: China's tech rise reshapes the global space race
entries.snippet: China is pulling ahead in global research rankings and expanding its ambitions in space. With growing technological leadership, Beijing is positioning itself as a rival to the United States on a global scale.

entries.title: South Korea plans future fund fueled by chip boom
entries.snippet: South Korea plans to channel windfall tax revenue from its booming semiconductor industry into a new future fund. The money would help finance major industrial projects and to support younger generations.

entries.title: Why US train travel lags behind Asia and Europe
entries.snippet: As flights get pricier and gas prices stay high, more US travelers are turning to trains — and hitting a system built for freight, not people.

entries.title: Iran: Pressure on persecuted Baha'i community intensifies
entries.snippet: Arrests, torture, mock executions: War has seen the Iranian regime crack down on dissidents of all kinds. Members of the country's Baha'i faith have long been persecuted, but their situation is now worsening.

entries.title: India news: Indian passport slips one spot in global ranking
entries.snippet: The Indian passport has slipped one spot below last year's ranking on the Global Passport Index. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: China frees pastor after Trump raised case with Xi
entries.snippet: China has released the pastor of a prominent underground church after US President Donald Trump pressed his case with Chinese leader Xi Jinping. His family hailed the move as a hopeful sign for religious freedom.

entries.title: Trump set to put NATO unity to the test at Turkey summit
entries.snippet: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte is working to keep the alliance united and Donald Trump engaged. But disputes over burden sharing, US military commitments, and the Iran war are creating a major test for NATO unity.

entries.title: Albania PM Rama: Protests a stage for anti-Trump forces
entries.snippet: Protesters in Albania say their government is selling the country its nature out to foreign investors and luxury developers. Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama tells DW why he thinks people are so upset.

entries.title: Jehovah's Witnesses fight German state for Holocaust archive
entries.snippet: The Jehovah's Witnesses have secured a partial victory in a dispute over a unique archive documenting the community's persecution by the Nazi regime. It comes after a new memorial to the victims was unveiled in Berlin.
